'''Masrii''' was [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] that was led and represented on the [[Three Families]] by [[Broga Masrii]].

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
It is implied that the Masrii kajidic exists by Masrii being [[Broga Masrii]]'s [[cuirvas]], which all Hutt clans are identified by. Also, it is one of the families represented on the [[Three Families]].
